## Life Summary

Lilian Jean (Jean) Kelly was born at Maitland on the Yorke Peninsula of South Australia. She married [[Sydney Hugh Parker (1922–1964)]] on 7 Jul 1945 in Riverton, South Australia. The couple lived in the Riverton/Robe area.

Following Sydney's death in 1964, she appears to have remained in the Kingston South East area, where she died on 12 May 2001 at age 78. She is buried alongside her husband at Robe Cemetery.
